comment: SE-CSLAM (pg grids) variant of capture_se_dycore.json: adds the fvm_struct tracer state (c/dp_fvm include the nhc halo ring; psc is nc x nc; se_flux spans nhe). fvm components are fixed-shape in CAM and allocatable in CAM-SIMA, like elem_state_t. Kept out of the np4 spec on purpose: with CSLAM off the fvm dummies are unallocated and a spec entry would only add per-hit error notes.
